Use-case & requirements (shorthand):
- Workload: embeddings for document and ticket corpus; nightly batch ingestion; semantic search + reranking for product UI.
- Throughput targets: sustained 350 qps for search during business-critical windows, 500 qps burst; cold-response SLA target ~150-200ms for single-vector nearest-neighbor queries (hosted) — willing to tolerate slightly higher for initial POC.
- Batch: monthly bulk embed of ~200k documents; need parallelized ingestion + retry semantics; cost sensitivity: want predictable unit cost per embed.
- Vector DB integration: preference to start with Postgres + pgvector (existing infra) but open to managed vector DB if integration simpler. Need clear connector pattern and migration story.
- Model preferences: high-quality embedding model; open to Redwood-verified open models or managed embeddings. Interested in quantized/dedicated inference later for cost.
- Routing/fallback: want automated fallback to lower-cost embedding variant during large batch jobs; must preserve accuracy thresholds.
- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML) required, audit logs for key events, KMS for key material, EU data residency for subsets of customer data.

POC scope & success criteria (shorthand):
- Ingest 50k sample documents into pgvector via Redwood embeddings pipeline; show end-to-end similarity search and rerank in product UI.
- Achieve average search latency <250ms for 95th pct during POC traffic profile.
- Run a nightly batch of 200k docs in test env and report per-embed cost and time-to-complete.
- Security sign-off: basic SOC2 evidence + SAML test account working.

Pricing / commercial notes:
- Initial ask: hosted API trial to validate latency/quality. If throughput/cost not acceptable, move to Dedicated reserved capacity.
- Finance requested: 12-month committed pricing for Dedicated (discounting tiers), and line-item for data residency add-on.
